gloss: to glare at, to stare at

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {睨|にら}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to glare at, to stare at
definitions.explanation: To look at someone with anger or hostility.

definitions.gloss: to suspect, to keep an eye on

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{睨|にら}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: They suspect him as the culprit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{怒|おこ}った→怒る：00876_okoru⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{睨|にら}んだ。
examples.english: They glared at me with an angry face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{睨|にら}み{合|あ}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The two glared at each other for a while.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{睨|にら}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The police suspect that man is the culprit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{怪|あや}しい→怪しい：10267_ayashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{睨|にら}んで、⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: Suspecting he was up to something, they investigated his actions.

notes:
{睨|にら}む conveys looking at someone with anger, hostility, or suspicion. The gaze carries emotional weight.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ particle for the target being glared at

ASPECT (ている):
{睨|にら}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing glare or maintained hostile attention.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{睨|にら}む: to glare into someone's eyes
- ⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧{睨|にら}む: to stare fixedly
- ⟦{睨|にら}みつける→睨みつける：13683_niramitsukeru⟧: to glare at intensely (compound verb)
- ⟦{睨|にら}み{合|あ}う→睨み合う：noentry⟧: to glare at each other

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {睨|にら}む: to glare (angry, hostile)
- ⟦{見|み}つめる→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧: to stare/gaze (neutral or affectionate)
- ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look (general, neutral)
